overview: A single cross-reference sheet concerning the procedure to be followed by American citizens who wished to contract marriages in the Kwantung Leased Territory. Dated September 2, 1939, and filed at Dairen under file number 133/2909, it directs the reader to paper no. 125 for the original document rather than reproducing the substantive instructions.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference sheet on American marriages in the Kwantung Leased Territory
subfiles.about: The sheet identifies and cross-references a paper concerning the procedure for American citizens contracting marriage in the Kwantung Leased Territory.
subfiles.summary: This administrative cross-reference records the subject of marriage procedures for American citizens in the Kwantung Leased Territory. It is dated September 2, 1939, associated with Dairen and file number 133/2909, and directs the reader to paper no. 125 for the original document. The sheet itself contains no details of the required marriage procedure.

interest: The sheet is useful as evidence of the State Department’s filing practices and of the existence of a separate document governing marriages by American citizens in Japanese-controlled Kwantung. Although it preserves none of the substantive procedure, its date, subject wording, Dairen provenance, and internal references may help a historian locate the missing original paper and reconstruct consular administration in the territory.
